problems_found_and_fixed: Vendor FBX scenes bring their own Camera3D/OmniLight3D: the builder now marks them import/skip_import in the .import file (re-import), and VisualSlots.make strips any camera/light left in a wrapper at runtime.

HumanoidBoneMapper wrote a bone map even when no core bone matched, which would break the import: it now refuses rigs with more than 4 unmapped core bones (MAX_MISSING_CORE) and the builder falls back to the model's own clips.
Embedded clips with generic names (Armature|Action) matched no state keyword: choices now accept "clips": {state: clip name}, and the report lists the embedded clip names.
A flat model fitted by height became 5.5 m long (spider): the builder now warns when a unit/enemy footprint exceeds its slot (1.2 m x space + 0.8).
RigLab now flags a humanoid slot whose rig has no humanoid bone map (shared Mixamo clips cannot play).
problems_open: facing_of() cannot tell the facing of a rig with generic bone names (reported 'unknown'): check the -Z arrow in RigLab and set rotation_y by hand.
Missing external textures: the FBX reference .jpg files by path; stage only copies files named *Texture* or in a Textures folder. Copy referenced textures next to the FBX manually.
Real humanoid FBX retargeting (Synty/Mixamo bone names through ufbx) still unverified against real files.
